question: Please find comments that contain "good", give me the top 10 comment ids sorted by newest first.
SQL: SELECT c.id AS id_external FROM STACKOVERFLOW.COMMENTS c WHERE c.text LIKE '%good%' ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please find the badge records issued between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, and give me the IDs of the top 10 badge records in reverse chronological order of issuance time.
SQL: SELECT b.id AS id_external FROM STACKOVERFLOW.BADGES b WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY b.date DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please help me count the number of active records generated by moderator nomination posts between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.POSTS_MODERATOR_NOMINATION pmn WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Please help me count how many different parent posts have been active between January 1, 2001, and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.parent_id) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW_POSTS p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Please calculate the average number of comments for active posts between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT AVG(p.comment_count) AS avg_quantity FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW_POSTS p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Check for me between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, what tag combinations were mainly used in moderator nomination posts, and give me the top 10 by frequency from high to low.
SQL: SELECT pmn.tags AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.POSTS_MODERATOR_NOMINATION pmn WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY pmn.tags ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please check for the period from January 1, 2001 to January 31, 2026, which moderator nomination post titles appear most frequently. Show me the top 10 in descending order of count.
SQL: SELECT pmn.title AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.POSTS_MODERATOR_NOMINATION pmn WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY pmn.title ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please check which users received the most badges between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, and give me the top 10 users in descending order of the number of badges obtained.
SQL: SELECT b.user_id AS rel_person, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.BADGES b WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY b.user_id ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to see how many posts in the community had active behaviors each day between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000.0)) AS day, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW_POSTS p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

question: I'd like to see the number of active posts for each post type per day from January 1, 2001 to January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000.0)) AS day, p.post_type_id AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW_POSTS p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day, p.post_type_id ORDER BY day, event_cnt DESC;

question: Help me find users who have been awarded at least 5 times between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, and list them in descending order by the number of awards.
SQL: SELECT CAST(b.user_id AS CHAR) AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.BADGES b WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY CAST(b.user_id AS CHAR) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: Please find the post types with active post counts higher than the average across all post types between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, and give me the top 10 sorted by count from high to low.
SQL: WITH topic_cnt AS ( SELECT p.post_type_id AS topic, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW_POSTS p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY p.post_type_id ), avg_cnt AS ( SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM topic_cnt ) SELECT topic, cnt FROM topic_cnt WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please show me the top 10 users and tag combinations with the highest activity count for moderator nomination related posts posted under different tag combinations between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, sorted in descending order by activity count.
SQL: SELECT pmn.owner_user_id AS rel_person, pmn.tags AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM STACKOVERFLOW.POSTS_MODERATOR_NOMINATION pmn WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(pmn.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY pmn.owner_user_id, pmn.tags ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please check the proportion of badges in the "Business" category under different tag based values between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT CAST(b.tag_based AS CHAR) AS category_topic, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.tag_based = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS ratio_in_status FROM STACKOVERFLOW.BADGES b WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY CAST(b.tag_based AS CHAR) ORDER BY ratio_in_status DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Please calculate the total number of comments on active posts between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026.
SQL: SELECT SUM(p.comment_count) AS total_quantity FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW_POSTS p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: Show me the top 10 tag combinations whose posts received the highest total views between January 1, 2001 and January 31, 2026, sorted by views in descending order.
SQL: SELECT p.tags AS category_topic, SUM(p.view_count) AS total_quantity FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW_POSTS p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.last_activity_date / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY p.tags ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Find the stations with daily observation records in 2018 and retrieve the top 10 station IDs ordered by the latest observation date descending.
SQL: SELECT o.id AS id_external FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY o.date DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Find the observation records marked as “7” in 2018 and which stations are involved. Give me the top 10 station IDs in reverse order of the latest observation date.
SQL: SELECT o.id AS id_external FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o WHERE o.sflag = '7' ORDER BY o.date DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Count the total number of daily observation records in 2018.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00';

question: Please help me calculate the total sum of observation values for all daily observation records in 2018.
SQL: SELECT SUM(o.value) AS total_amount FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00';

question: Help me calculate the average observation value of the daily observation records in 2018.
SQL: SELECT AVG(o.value) AS avg_amount FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00';

question: Please check for the first half of 2018, which stations have the most daily observation records, and give me the top 10 station names in descending order by record count.
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o JOIN GHCN_D.GHCND_STATIONS st ON st.id = o.id WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2018-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Help me check which stations had the highest total observations in the first half of 2018, and give me the top 10 station names in descending order of the total sum.
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, SUM(o.value) AS total_amount FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o JOIN GHCN_D.GHCND_STATIONS st ON st.id = o.id WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2018-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show me the top 10 latitude and longitude locations with the highest number of daily observation records from their corresponding stations in the first half of 2018, sorted by record count from high to low.
SQL: SELECT CONCAT(CAST(st.latitude AS CHAR), ',', CAST(st.longitude AS CHAR)) AS location, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o JOIN GHCN_D.GHCND_STATIONS st ON st.id = o.id WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2018-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY location ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I would like to see how many daily observation records there are for each day in 2018.
SQL: SELECT DATE(o.date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

question: I want to see the total sum of observation values for each month in 2018.
SQL: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(o.value) AS total_amount FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: Find the stations with no less than 10 records in the first half of 2018, and list them in descending order by record count.
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o JOIN GHCN_D.GHCND_STATIONS st ON st.id = o.id WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2018-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY st.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: Help me check which stations have the highest average observation value in the first half of 2018, and give me the top 10 station names sorted by average observation value from highest to lowest.
SQL: SELECT st.name AS name_entity, AVG(o.value) AS avg_amount FROM GHCN_D.GHCND_2018 o JOIN GHCN_D.GHCND_STATIONS st ON st.id = o.id WHERE o.date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2018-07-01 00:00:00' AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.name ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to check whether there are keywords like “good” in NuGet package dependency declarations (such as a package name or framework identifier). Give me the first 10 versions that matched in the most recent snapshot.
SQL: SELECT nr.Version AS id_external FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.NUGETREQUIREMENTS nr WHERE CAST(nr.DependencyGroups AS CHAR) LIKE '%good%' ORDER BY nr.SnapshotAt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Within the snapshot window from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', what are the version records of NuGet packages (sorted by capture time in descending order)? Show the first 10 entries.
SQL: SELECT nr.Version AS id_external FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.NUGETREQUIREMENTS nr WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(nr.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(nr.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY nr.SnapshotAt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many NuGet Requirements records did we capture in total?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.NUGETREQUIREMENTS nr WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(nr.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(nr.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many distinct dependents (the downstream dependents that were counted) appeared in the dependency snapshots?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(d.Dependent AS CHAR)) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59';

question: During the period from 2001-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-01-31 23:59:59, how many dependent records were collected for each ecosystem (e.g., NPM/MAVEN)? I want to see which systems have the highest data volume—give me the Top 10.
SQL: SELECT d.System AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY d.System ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', how many distinct dependents (downstream dependents) have appeared across all package manager ecosystems? Rank the top 10 by coverage.
SQL: SELECT d.System AS category_topic, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(d.Dependent AS CHAR)) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY d.System ORDER BY distinct_entity_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: During the period '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which packages (Name) have the highest number of dependent records? I want to find the top 10 popular packages in the dependency network.
SQL: SELECT d.Name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY d.Name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: View the dependency snapshot collection volume per day between '2001-01-01 00:00:00' and '2026-01-31 23:59:59': how many dependent records were added/collected each day?
SQL: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000.0)) AS day, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE d.SnapshotAt >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2001-01-01 00:00:00') * 1000000.0 AND d.SnapshotAt < UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-01-31 23:59:59') * 1000000.0 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

question: View the change in ecosystem distribution: what are the daily collection counts for each package management system (System) during the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59'?
SQL: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000.0)) AS day, d.System AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day, d.System ORDER BY day, event_cnt DESC;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which packages frequently appeared (with no fewer than 10 records)? I would like to get a priority monitoring list.
SQL: SELECT d.Name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY d.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: During the period from '2001-01-01 00:00:00' to '2026-01-31 23:59:59', which package management ecosystems (System) have collection volumes higher than the overall average? List the top 10 systems by collection volume in descending order.
SQL: WITH topic_cnt AS ( SELECT d.System AS topic, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM DEPS_DEV_V1.DEPENDENTS d WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) >= '2001-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(d.SnapshotAt / 1000000) < '2026-01-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY d.System ), avg_cnt AS ( SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM topic_cnt ) SELECT topic, cnt FROM topic_cnt WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I'm verifying the injury outcomes of fatal traffic accidents in 2016: please retrieve the accident numbers where the injury severity contains "Fatal", and list the top 10 in reverse chronological order of accident occurrence time.
SQL: SELECT p.consecutive_number AS id_external FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PERSON_2016 p WHERE p.injury_severity_name LIKE '%Fatal%' ORDER BY p.timestamp_of_crash DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to retrieve a list of fatal traffic accident cases that occurred within a certain time window in 2016: please return the accident serial number (consecutive number) in descending order of accident time, and give me the top 10 for sample review.
SQL: SELECT a.consecutive_number AS id_external FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59' ORDER BY a.timestamp_of_crash DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I am verifying the alcohol test execution status for individuals involved in cases in 2016: please filter out the accident numbers corresponding to records where the alcohol test status is 'Test Given', and provide the top 10 records in descending order of accident occurrence time.
SQL: SELECT p.consecutive_number AS id_external FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PERSON_2016 p WHERE p.alcohol_test_status1 = 'Test Given' ORDER BY p.timestamp_of_crash DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to perform a spot check between May and July 2016: filter records where the alcohol test status is 'Test Given' and the injury description contains “Fatal”, output the corresponding accident numbers, and give me the top 10 in reverse chronological order of accident time.
SQL: SELECT p.consecutive_number AS id_external FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PERSON_2016 p WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(p.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-05-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(p.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-07-31 23:59:59' AND p.alcohol_test_status1 = 'Test Given' AND p.injury_severity_name LIKE CONCAT('%', 'Fatal', '%') ORDER BY p.timestamp_of_crash DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I need to assess the scale of fatal traffic accidents within a certain time window in 2016, in order to compare the total volume during risk periods such as holidays and severe weather. Please count the number of accidents during that period.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59';

question: I want to see the vehicle make coverage of fatal crashes during a certain period in 2016: please count the distinct number of different vehicle make codes (vehicle make) that appeared in that period.
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.vehicle_make) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_VEHICLE_2016 v WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(v.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(v.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59';

question: I want to estimate the average death number for each accident within a certain period of 2016 to compare the differences in accident severity across different time periods. Please output the average of number_of_fatalities.
SQL: SELECT AVG(a.number_of_fatalities) AS avg_quantity FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59';

question: Based on the data on traffic accidents that occurred in the United States in 2016, compile a risk heatmap by state: tally the number of fatal accidents by state (state_name) and list the top 10 states from highest to lowest.
SQL: SELECT a.state_name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY a.state_name ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to see the distribution of pedestrian-related accidents in a certain period of 2016 on the dimension of located position: Please count the number of incidents by location category, and give me the top 10 high-frequency location types.
SQL: SELECT pb.pedestrian_position AS location, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PBTYPE_2016 pb JOIN NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a ON a.consecutive_number = pb.consecutive_number WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY pb.pedestrian_position ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to investigate repeated occurrences from the dimension of vehicle registered owner (registered_vehicle_owner) within a certain period in 2016: which owner codes are associated with more accident records? Please give me the top 10.
SQL: SELECT v.registered_vehicle_owner AS rel_person, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_VEHICLE_2016 v WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(v.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(v.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY v.registered_vehicle_owner ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I need to extract the daily trend of fatal accidents for a specific period in 2016 to compare impacts such as holidays and extreme weather: Please count the number of accidents per day and output them in chronological order.
SQL: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000.0)) AS day, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;

question: I want to identify the key states where the number of accidents reached a threshold during a certain period in 2016, so as to facilitate more detailed breakdown of collision patterns and road environment in subsequent analysis. Please list the states with no fewer than 10 accidents, and output them in descending order by the number of accidents.
SQL: SELECT a.state_name AS name_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-12-31 23:59:59' GROUP BY a.state_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY event_cnt DESC;

question: Based on the 2016 U.S. traffic accident fatality data, find the states where fatal accidents occurred in the first half of the year due to vehicle BACKING, return the list of states sorted alphabetically, and output the top 10.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT a.state_name AS name_entity FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_VEHICLE_2016 v JOIN NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a ON a.consecutive_number = v.consecutive_number AND a.state_number = v.state_number WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(v.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(v.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-07-01 00:00:00' AND v.crash_type_name LIKE '%BACKING%' ORDER BY a.state_name LIMIT 10;

question: I want to summarize the fatality scale in January 2016: Please calculate the cumulative value of accidental deaths during that period, to be used together with the number of accidents for risk intensity assessment.
SQL: SELECT SUM(a.number_of_fatalities) AS total_quantity FROM NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_PLUS.NHTSA_TRAFFIC_FATALITIES_ACCIDENT_2016 a WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(a.timestamp_of_crash / 1000000) < '2016-01-31 23:59:59';

question: I want to first confirm how many image records (row count) are in the MegaMovie image library (PHOTOS_V_0_2).
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.PHOTOS_V_0_2 p;

question: How many distinct upload sessions (deduplicated by upload_session_id) are in PHOTOS_V_0_2?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.upload_session_id) AS distinct_external_cnt FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.PHOTOS_V_0_2 p;

question: How many distinct index catalog entries (INDEXID deduplication) are involved in the astrometric matching log?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.INDEXID) AS distinct_entity_cnt FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.ASTROMETRY_MATCH_V_0_4 m;

question: In the astrometric matching log, which index entries (INDEXID) are matched/triggered most frequently? Give me the top 10 by the number of match events.
SQL: SELECT m.INDEXID AS rel_entity, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.ASTROMETRY_MATCH_V_0_4 m GROUP BY m.INDEXID ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: I want to roughly overview the distribution of the cumulative amount (sum of FIELDID) by different INDEXID in the match log. What are the top 10 INDEXID?
SQL: SELECT m.INDEXID AS rel_entity, SUM(m.FIELDID) AS total_quantity FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.ASTROMETRY_MATCH_V_0_4 m GROUP BY m.INDEXID ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In this image library, how many images are there for each image format (image_type, e.g., JPEG/ARW)? Top 10 by count.
SQL: SELECT p.image_type AS category_topic, COUNT(*) AS event_cnt FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.PHOTOS_V_0_2 p GROUP BY p.image_type ORDER BY event_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the approximate average width of images captured by different camera makes? I want to see the differences in resolution specifications across makes. Show the top 10.
SQL: SELECT p.make AS name_entity, AVG(p.width) AS avg_quantity FROM ECLIPSE_MEGAMOVIE.PHOTOS_V_0_2 p WHERE p.width IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.make ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;
